channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: AI controls fusion plasma faster than human reaction time
item.description: Princeton researchers tested an AI system that monitors and controls fusion plasma in milliseconds, outperforming human operators in speed.

item.title: Earth's signal might be dark matter, scientists suggest
item.description: Scientists used Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere as a giant detector to search for lightweight dark matter candidates.

item.title: Indonesia's most dangerous fires burn underground
item.description: Indonesia's peat fires are surging early in the 2026 fire season due to a strengthening El Niño and severe drought drying out wetlands.

item.title: Scientists find a weak spot in one of the deadliest brain cancers
item.description: Researchers may have found a new way to weaken glioblastoma's defenses. Blocking the protein SET prevented tumors from forming.
